description: Switch values of the design-2 rules (design2_rules, D2-1 to D2-9 and the second edition of D2-5, D2-7, D2-8 and D2-9). Nothing here is read unless replay.py is run with --design 2. The block `edition1` lists the values of the first edition that the second edition replaces; they stay selectable with --d2-edition 1 so that a first-edition run can be repeated.

edition2.description: Second edition of the rules (design2_rules, second edition). Defaults of --design 2 unless --d2-edition 1.
edition2.hold_rule: T_hold = L_F + 500 blocks of the reference chain (2 s); other chains convert the seconds

k_table.worst_case: every settlement at v_max, every one inspected; F <= Bin(S, w)

sales_cap.lambda_rule: Lambda = failure window + hold period (2 * T_hold when they are equal)
sales_cap.refill_rule: r_S = floor((S - q_S) * 10^6 / Lambda) ppm per block

base.source: operating point chain.block_seconds (Base, one sequencer, 2 s blocks)

polygon.source: collection ledger, section 4: about 2 s; the tuning list itself shows 1.5 s (measured_in_list)

solana.source: collection ledger, section 4: about 0.4 s; the tuning list itself shows 0.30 s (measured_in_list)
